name: country-select
title: Country Select
description: A searchable country picker returning the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, with flag + name. A thin wrapper over SearchableSelect fed by the geo-data item.

meta.whenToUse: Collecting a country in an address/billing form — store the ISO code.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small fixed option set (Select) or multi-select.
